name: Laced Pumpkin
summary: At Apothecary Johaan's hand, Laced Pumpkin tests the reach of Forsaken alchemy. In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society seeks weapons against the Scourge and living human forces.

sections.title: A Bitter Harvest
sections.body: In Tirisfal Glades, pumpkins look like ordinary produce salvaged from blighted soil. In Brill, Apothecary Johaan treats one with experimental toxins to test the full potential of undeath. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks weapons against the Scourge in the north and living human forces advancing from the south. Even a simple harvest can carry infection and chemical death.

sections.title: The Cellar Experiment
sections.body: In the cellar of the Gallows' End Tavern, Forsaken captors hold a famished Captured Scarlet Zealot. Desperate for nourishment, the prisoner accepts a tainted offering. The laced pumpkin holds Apothecary Johaan's concoction. Eating it triggers a violent transformation: the human zealot becomes a mindless ghoul, stumbles briefly in agony, then collapses dead on the cold stone floor.

faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan in Brill treats an ordinary field gourd with an experimental formula. The concoction tests the effects of Forsaken alchemy on living subjects.
Forsaken captors imprison a Captured Scarlet Zealot in the cellar beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. After being starved, the prisoner eats the tainted offering.

faq.q: What happens when someone eats the pumpkin?
faq.answer: The pumpkin's concoction triggers a violent transformation. The prisoner becomes a mindless ghoul, stumbles briefly in agony, then collapses dead on the cold stone floor.

faq.q: Why did the Forsaken make this?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan and the Royal Apothecary Society make biological concoctions to combat the Scourge in the north and living humans advancing from the south. They use captured enemies as test subjects.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know the Royal Apothecary Society will use any means to secure Tirisfal against zealous living crusaders. Turning ordinary food into a weapon shows their pragmatism.
As Alliance, you know a captured zealot faces a grotesque fate in Forsaken territory. His end is a stark reminder of what may await living humans taken alive.
